ledger.note: 1893: the Fulani. The page says the Fulani jihad of Modibo Adama began against Mandara in 1809 ("the kingdom faced a setback in 1809") and that it "finally fell to them in 1893"; yet the Germans conquer it in 1902 and the page does not say the Fulani held it. Recorded as a contest, not a loss, at confidence 1.

sources.title: Mandara Kingdom
sources.note: Infobox c. 1500-1902, Dulo c. 1580, Bornu 1614 and c. 1781, Fulani 1809 and 1893, German conquest 1902, France 1918.

notes:
Mandara Kingdom (Wandala), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Mandara Kingdom (the Wandala people page did not load).

Thin page: no outline, no month for the German conquest, no Rabih or Bagirmi relation ("page silent"), no tribute years for Bornu beyond the 1614 installation (Bornu's ledger should carry the vassal period) and no statement about the Fulani holding Mandara between 1893 and 1902; hence the contest rather than a loss for 1893-1902. The Maroua disc has no support beyond "Mandara Mountains of present-day Cameroon".
